note: INCOME TAX ON SALARY — the rules TDS Declaration, Investment Proofs and the payroll's monthly TDS read. EVERY FIGURE HERE IS LAW, NOT CODE: a Budget changes this file, never PHP. One block per financial year (April–March), keyed 'YYYY-YY'. Amounts are rupees as decimal strings. Section names show the Income-tax Act, 2025 number (in force from 1 April 2026) with the 1961 Act number employees still know. VERIFY AGAINST THE FINANCE ACT / CBDT NOTIFICATIONS BEFORE GO-LIVE — compiled 14 Oct 2026 from public sources (cleartax.in, incometaxindia-based summaries); a named compliance owner should sign it off.

2026-27.label: Tax Year 2026-27 (Income-tax Act, 2025)
2026-27.regime_note: The new regime is the default (Section 202). An employee opts for the old regime by declaring it to the employer (Form 122 / Form 124) — salaried employees may switch every year.

hra.note: Old regime only. Exempt HRA = the least of (a) HRA received, (b) rent paid − 10% of salary, (c) 50% of salary in a metro city / 40% elsewhere. Salary = Basic + DA. Income Tax Rules 2026 add Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune and Ahmedabad to the 50% cities. Landlord PAN is required when annual rent exceeds ₹1,00,000.

groups.label: Section 123 (old 80C) — investments & payments
groups.note: One combined limit of ₹1,50,000 for everything in this group, including your PF from salary, 80CCC pension and your own NPS 80CCD(1).

groups.label: Section 124 (old 80CCD(2)) — employer's NPS contribution
groups.note: Both regimes. Limited to 14% of Basic + DA.

groups.label: Section 126 (old 80D) — health insurance
groups.note: Self/spouse/children ₹25,000 (₹50,000 if you are 60+); parents a further ₹25,000 (₹50,000 if a parent is 60+). Preventive check-up up to ₹5,000 is within these limits.

groups.label: Other deductions (Chapter VIII, old Chapter VI-A)
Income from house property (Section 22, old 24(b))
groups.note: Interest on a loan for the house you live in: up to ₹2,00,000. Old regime only.
